default_when_absent: lnk_presence()'s default groups (salmon: ch cm co pk sk; ct_dv_rb: ct dv rb)
description: Name of a set of species that share presence: where any member is present in a watershed group, every member is (lnk_presence()). Rows of one group keep their file order, which reaches the acc spec. Not the species_groups.csv groups, which pool fish records (#290).
One member species, one row each, as a wsg_species_presence column (matched lower case). A species may belong to one group only.
